# Task 08

I implemented artifact handling in GitHub Actions by creating and uploading a build artifact in one job and downloading it in a dependent job. This helped me understand how artifacts are used to pass data between jobs and how job dependencies work in real CI pipelines.

# Task 09

I implemented conditional execution in GitHub Actions to control step execution based on the branch. The deployment step runs only when changes are pushed to the main branch and is skipped on develop. This helped me understand how to use if conditions and GitHub context variables to safely manage branch-based workflows

![Task 8](https://github.com/sachilz/github-actions-learning/blob/working-advanced-sachintha/.github/submissions/Proof/4.png)

# Task 10

I practiced the GitHub contribution workflow by creating a feature branch, opening a pull request using the provided PR template, and submitting an issue using an issue template. This task helped me understand how teams collaborate using structured PRs and issues in real-world projects
